label: CARD-NLR-like system
definition: A CARD-NLR system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder CARD_NLR_like subtype locus represented by the CARD_NLR_like rule row requiring two matches from the CARD_NLR__Endonuclease, CARD_NLR__Phospho_Trypsin, CARD_NLR__Subtilase_long_new, and CARD_NLR__Trypsin_Phospho effector-profile set and four genes overall after considering CARD_NLR__CARD_Protease, CARD_NLR__NLR_new, and CARD_NLR__Trypsin accessory profiles.
observations: CARD-NLR-like branch under CARD-NLR system; distinct from the broader CARD-NLR system, CARD_NLR_GasderMIN, CARD_NLR_Endonuclease, CARD_NLR_Phospho, or CARD_NLR_Subtilase subtypes, individual CARD-like, NLR-like, Trypsin, endonuclease, phospho-trypsin, or subtilase-family proteins, exact phage triggers, native host breadth, unresolved two-of-four effector-profile semantics, unresolved CARD_NLR__Subtilase_long_new HMM inventory coverage, DefenseFinder HMM rows, and other phage-defense systems.
